rv.q: But in practice, it is both an amusing indictment of our soul-crushing go-go-go ethos and a gleeful conjuring of community.
The show delivers a swift and agreeable serving of escapist entertainment and what’s wrong with that?
This hyperactive, interactive, competitive show may not wind up running for 34 years at Theater like 'Blue Man Group.'
Wildly fun and unlike anything else on stage right now, Burnout Paradise is a singular theatre experience.
So run, yes run, don’t walk and get yourself a ticket to a show that will have you urging on others who are sweating buckets for your sole entertainment pleasure.
It is chaotic, communal, and a genuine blast.
If you need a little lift just now -- and who doesn't?
But if you are looking for a mindless, game-like performance that is guaranteed to make you laugh, don’t think twice, this is Paradise.
For me, though, the show outran its premise before my interest ran out.
Over time, I felt mostly exhausted by the sensory overload.
